# dagr repository

> Dagr is a programmable monorepo build system. This repository contains the execution engine and independently consumable calculation components.

## Areas

- [Engine](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/tree/main/engine): CLI, graph loading, execution, Docker integration, mounts, docs, and examples.
- [Reusable components](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/tree/main/components): TypeScript build stack, DI calculation primitive, component tests, mounting, and publication.

- [Engine LLM index](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/engine/docs/llms.txt)
- [Components LLM index](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/components/llms.txt)
- [Repository README](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/README.md)
